case: a cable post screwed down with a countersunk wood screw: a cone D8.38 > 4.4 x 2.2 over a D4.4 hole, which is an M4 clearance and also in the band of an M3 insert. The screw's component bundles screws, inserts and washers: its name says inserts, the body is the screw. It was read as an insert pocket. Its class is recomputed with the names on its axis: the stored one is what the classifier gives without names
